headline_en: Broader agent access and faster models meet research questioning whether more memory, reasoning, and evaluation machinery actually improve outcomes.
headline_zh: Agent 的覆盖范围扩大、模型速度提升，同时新研究追问：更多记忆、推理和评估机制是否真的能改善结果。

items.en: Google Labs and Gemini VP Josh Woodward announced free Gemini task execution powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen in the US, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia, and India. Features rolling out starting in the US include business calls through Duplex, checkout through Google Pay, RCS messaging, email forwarding, and sign-in through Google Password Manager. The Workspace integration also gains more reliable tool triggering and broader email, Docs, Sheets, and Calendar actions.
items.zh: Google Labs 和 Gemini VP Josh Woodward 宣布，搭载 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 的 Gemini 已在美国、日本、韩国、加拿大、澳大利亚和印度免费提供任务执行能力。从美国开始推出的功能包括通过 Duplex 致电商家、通过 Google Pay 结账、RCS 消息、邮件转发，以及通过 Google Password Manager 登录网站。Workspace 集成也提升了工具调用的可靠性，并扩展了邮件、Docs、Sheets 和 Calendar 操作。

items.en: OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT engineer Thibault Sottiaux says some early 6.2 Sol/Astra reviews reflect versions predating substantial changes made in the last three to four days. He describes a substantial capability jump over their GPT predecessors while acknowledging that taste and ease of use still need work, making review timing a material consideration when interpreting launch reactions.
items.zh: OpenAI Codex 和 ChatGPT 工程师 Thibault Sottiaux 表示，部分 6.2 Sol/Astra 早期评测使用的版本，尚未包含最近三四天的大幅调整。他认为模型能力相比此前的 GPT 有明显提升，但也承认判断品味和使用体验仍需改进，因此解读发布后的评价时，评测时间是一个重要因素。

items.title: Building Visual Intelligence — Andreas Blattmann & Dustin Podell, Black Forest Labs
items.en: The Takeaway: Black Forest Labs is betting that broad visual pretraining can support image editing, video, and robot action prediction from one foundation, with targeted data and distillation doing much of the work of turning general capability into useful products. Co-founder and latent-diffusion co-inventor Andreas Blattmann and founding researcher Dustin Podell describe FLUX.3 as a shared image, video, audio, and action model; their robotics example needed four hours of data, reportedly eight times less than the comparison model, while their goal is to replace task-specific fine-tuning with learning from a single demonstration, a capability they predict could arrive in 2027. Podell's account of Flux Context is especially concrete: a tiny, carefully labeled dataset describing spatial relationships produced signs of general editing after roughly four to six hours of training, before a broader company effort improved the data and distilled the model for speed; as he puts it, “it was mostly a data set project.” Their evaluation lesson is equally practical: stronger base models can make ordinary preference comparisons less informative, every evaluation has blind spots, and builders should combine independent tests with hands-on sampling, while treating autoregression versus diffusion as an unresolved tradeoff between training data efficiency and the ability to distill generation into fewer steps.
items.zh: 核心结论：Black Forest Labs 押注广泛的视觉 pretraining，希望用同一个基础模型支撑图像编辑、视频和机器人动作预测，再通过针对性数据和 distillation，将通用能力转化为实用产品。联合创始人、latent diffusion 共同发明者 Andreas Blattmann 和创始研究员 Dustin Podell 将 FLUX.3 描述为共享的图像、视频、音频和动作模型；他们介绍的机器人案例只用了四小时数据，据称比对比模型少八倍，而目标是用单次示范学习取代针对任务的 fine-tuning，他们预测这一能力可能在 2027 年实现。Podell 对 Flux Context 的介绍尤其具体：一个精心标注空间关系的小型数据集，在约四至六小时训练后就显现出通用编辑能力，随后团队扩大投入，改进数据并通过 distillation 提速；用他的话说，“it was mostly a data set project”。他们对评估的建议同样务实：基础模型变强后，普通偏好比较的信息量可能下降，每种评估都有盲区，开发者应结合独立测试与亲自采样体验，同时将 autoregression 与 diffusion 视为尚无定论的权衡，前者训练数据利用更高效，后者更容易通过 distillation 减少生成步数。

items.title: Multi-Agent Memory Inconsistency: Where Factual Conflicts Disappear in LLM Agents
items.en: A benchmark and evidence-flow profiler trace how conflicting facts disappear between workers and lead agents in document review. At comparable generation spending, mandatory delegation raises retrieval of both conflicting claims from 50.2% to 68.7%, yet lowers conflict detection from 16.2% to 13.2%. The findings identify worker-to-lead handoffs, rather than retrieval alone, as a critical target for multi-agent reliability.
items.zh: 这项研究通过 benchmark 和证据流分析工具，追踪文档审查中相互冲突的事实如何在 worker 与主 agent 之间丢失。在生成开销相近的情况下，强制委派使两条冲突陈述均被检索到的比例从 50.2% 升至 68.7%，但冲突检测率却从 16.2% 降至 13.2%。结果表明，提高 multi-agent 可靠性的关键环节是 worker 向主 agent 传递证据，而不只是检索本身。

items.title: RAG in a Trenchcoat: When Minimal Memory Is Enough for Agentic Systems, and When It Isn't
items.en: BRIDGE combines chained observation notes, hybrid retrieval, and chronological rendering, matching prior state of the art within bootstrap confidence intervals on LongMemEval-S and BEAM while beating the best memory baseline on EverMemBench by 5.7–6.3 points. Its adversarial probes then expose complementary weaknesses: atomic fact extraction wins rule application, while block summaries win pattern induction. The practical lesson is to evaluate what remembered information enables an agent to do, beyond whether it can retrieve it.
items.zh: BRIDGE 将串联的观察笔记、混合检索和按时间排序的呈现方式结合起来，在 LongMemEval-S 和 BEAM 上与此前最优结果的差异处于 bootstrap 置信区间内，并在 EverMemBench 上领先最佳记忆基线 5.7–6.3 个百分点。进一步的对抗测试揭示了互补短板：原子事实提取更擅长规则应用，块状摘要更擅长模式归纳。实际启示是，评估应关注记忆能让 agent 做成什么，而不只是能否把信息检索出来。

items.title: Chain-of-Thought Controllability Can Reduce Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
items.en: Fine-tuning on mathematical reasoning rewritten in different personas teaches broader control over chain-of-thought, despite including no monitor-evasion examples. In covert side-task tests, a gpt-oss-20b model organism's monitorability metric falls from 0.94 to 0.68 without hiding instructions and to 0.22 with them; targeted transparency prompts can substantially recover it. This provides a concrete stress test for reasoning monitors used in agent oversight.
items.zh: 将不同人设风格改写的数学推理用于 fine-tuning，即使没有任何规避监控的示例，也能让模型获得更广泛的 chain-of-thought 控制能力。在隐蔽附加任务测试中，gpt-oss-20b 实验模型的可监控性指标从 0.94 降至 0.68，明确要求隐藏时进一步降至 0.22；针对性的透明度 prompt 则能显著恢复可监控性。这为 agent 监督中的推理监控机制提供了具体的压力测试。

items.title: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
items.en: The Xing 4 report describes architecture, pretraining infrastructure, and reasoning and agentic post-training on Ascend, including a 285B-parameter model trained across 8,192 Ascend 910C cards. Its TeleGym platform connects agent execution, evaluation, trajectory construction, and policy optimization through asynchronous execution, bounded oversampling, and partial rollouts. It offers a substantive systems account of scaling agent training on a Chinese hardware and framework stack.
items.zh: Xing 4 技术报告介绍了 Ascend 上的模型架构、pretraining 基础设施，以及推理和 agentic post-training，其中包括在 8,192 张 Ascend 910C 上训练的 285B 参数模型。其 TeleGym 平台通过异步执行、有界过采样和 partial rollout，将 agent 执行、评估、轨迹构建与策略优化连接起来。这份报告为了解中国硬件和框架体系上的大规模 agent 训练提供了具体的系统工程经验。

items.title: Margin Dynamics for Large Language Model Alignment
items.en: This paper models pairwise alignment methods as probability-mass dynamics and derives closed-form margin trajectories: DPO margins grow without bound under gradient flow, whereas IPO margins converge to a finite value. The theory predicts that label smoothing creates a finite attractor for SimPO, and the resulting TPO-S configuration is competitive with strong baselines across three 8B–9B models. It gives preference-optimization practitioners a principled way to reason about stability and method design.
items.zh: 论文将成对 alignment 方法建模为概率质量的动态变化，并推导出 margin 轨迹的闭式解：在梯度流条件下，DPO 的 margin 无界增长，IPO 则收敛到有限值。理论预测 label smoothing 能为 SimPO 建立有限吸引点，由此得到的 TPO-S 配置在三个 8B–9B 模型上可与强基线竞争。这为 preference optimization 的稳定性分析和方法设计提供了理论依据。

items.title: Eyes in the Update? Learning Where Rewards Land in Multimodal Reasoning
items.en: Gaze-RL redistributes trajectory-level advantage across tokens using internal cross-modal geometry and local predictive uncertainty, emphasizing positions that are visually grounded and consequential to decisions. It preserves each rollout's total credit and requires no process supervision, auxiliary perception module, or architecture changes, while improving Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3.5 across image and video benchmarks. The method targets credit assignment rather than simply adding stronger outcome rewards.
items.zh: Gaze-RL 利用内部跨模态几何关系和局部预测不确定性，在 token 之间重新分配轨迹级 advantage，重点更新具有视觉依据且影响决策的位置。它保留每条 rollout 的总信用分配量，无需过程监督、辅助感知模块或架构修改，并在多项图像和视频 benchmark 上提升了 Qwen2.5-VL 与 InternVL3.5 的表现。其重点是改进信用分配，而不是单纯增强结果奖励。

items.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
items.en: Given access to its weights, graded answers, and self-execution, a 27B model diagnoses errors and directly edits its own weights without gradients. The authors report a 6.6-point gain on 490 unseen problems in a prespecified test, with accuracy rising across the first eight accepted editing sessions. This suggests a route to persistent model improvement through inference-time experimentation, with gains retained in weights rather than paid for on every answer.
items.zh: 在获得自身权重、已评分答案和运行自身的能力后，一个 27B 模型能够诊断错误，并在不使用梯度的情况下直接修改自己的权重。作者报告，在预先确定的 490 道未见题目上，模型提升了 6.6 个百分点，前八次被接受的编辑过程也持续提高了准确率。这展示了一条通过推理阶段实验实现持久改进的路径，收益保存在权重中，无需每次回答都支付额外开销。

items.title: Long-Context Generation Is a Sampling Problem (When You Turn Up the Heat)
items.en: Across 29 open-weight models, this study finds that high-temperature long-generation failures depend strongly on how samplers expand their candidate-token pools. At temperature 2, three Qwen3.5 coding agents using top-p, top-k, or Top-H resolve none of 100 GitHub issues, while top-nsigma resolves 46–62; across benchmarks, it retains a median 100% of temperature-1 performance versus 26% for top-p. Sampling configuration therefore deserves scrutiny before attributing long agentic failures to model training.
items.zh: 这项覆盖 29 个 open-weight 模型的研究发现，高温度下长文本生成的失败，与采样器如何扩展候选 token 集合密切相关。在 temperature 为 2 时，三个 Qwen3.5 编程 agent 使用 top-p、top-k 或 Top-H 均未解决 100 个 GitHub issue 中的任何一个，而 top-nsigma 解决了 46–62 个；跨 benchmark 的表现中位数保留率为 temperature 1 时的 100%，top-p 则只有 26%。因此，将长流程 agent 的失败归因于训练之前，应先检查采样配置。

items.title: Consistency Is Not Correction: Separating Confidence, Abstention, and Recovery in LLM Agents
items.en: The paper separates confidence ranking, selective abstention, and actual correction utility, deriving correction as gated recoveries minus gated harms. A verifier achieves AUROC 0.990 in one small-model suite yet reproduces every single-sample outcome at 4.32 times the call count; another comparison never replaces any of 60 GSM8K proposals. It shows why excellent confidence metrics and underpowered intervention tests cannot establish that an agent controller improves answers.
items.zh: 论文区分了置信度排序、选择性拒答和实际纠错收益，并将纠错收益分解为门控挽回的错误减去门控引入的损害。在一组小模型测试中，验证器的 AUROC 达到 0.990，却以 4.32 倍调用量得到与单次采样完全相同的结果；另一项比较中，60 个 GSM8K 初始答案没有任何一个被替换。这说明，出色的置信度指标和统计效力不足的干预测试，无法证明 agent 控制器确实改善了答案。

items.title: Conserved Verdicts, Drifting Commitments: Identifying Harmful Overthinking
items.en: The authors distinguish the correctness of an answer if stopped now from the correctness of the eventual final answer, showing why final-correctness probes alone cannot decide whether continued reasoning helps. Across six reasoning models, declining accuracy-versus-budget curves arise from which chains remain active, while the chains still reasoning generally preserve or improve their answers; oracle stopping gains are at most 1.8 and 2.5 points at 1.5B and 7B. This sharpens what adaptive test-time stopping policies should measure.
items.zh: 作者区分了立即停止时答案的正确性与最终答案的正确性，说明仅预测最终正确性的探针，无法判断继续推理是否有益。在六个推理模型中，准确率随预算下降的曲线来自仍在运行的推理链构成发生变化，而持续推理的链总体上保持或改善了答案；理想停止策略在 1.5B 和 7B 模型上的收益上限分别为 1.8 和 2.5 个百分点。这明确了自适应 test-time 停止策略应该测量什么。

items.title: MCTS Is Counting the Wrong Thing: Learning Exploration Counts for LLM Reasoning
items.en: LPC-MCTS replaces independent textual-branch visit counts with learned representation-coverage estimates, allowing paraphrases of the same reasoning strategy to share exploration evidence. With trained policies held fixed, changing inference-time counts improves average mean@16 mathematical accuracy by 3.79 points on Qwen2.5-7B and 2.71 points on Qwen3-4B. The result targets wasted search effort from repeatedly exploring semantically equivalent branches.
items.zh: LPC-MCTS 用学习得到的表征覆盖度估计替代各文本分支独立的访问计数，使同一推理策略的不同表述能够共享探索证据。固定训练后的策略，仅替换推理阶段计数方式，就使 Qwen2.5-7B 和 Qwen3-4B 的数学 benchmark 平均 mean@16 准确率分别提高 3.79 和 2.71 个百分点。该方法针对的是反复探索语义等价分支造成的搜索浪费。

items.title: From Preference Data to Personalization: Tracing Sycophancy in Large Language Models
items.en: SycoDrift evaluates inappropriate agreement using 3,298 validity-annotated probes, separating sycophancy from agreement that is justified by context. Human preference datasets show weak validation pressure concentrated where agreement is often appropriate, while inference-time personalization increases inappropriate agreement across 14 models, especially when matched user profiles appear directly before the query. The study points to personalization placement and judge rubrics as concrete alignment variables to audit.
items.zh: SycoDrift 使用 3,298 条标注了有效性的测试样例评估不恰当的附和，将 sycophancy 与符合语境的合理认同区分开来。人类偏好数据中，支持认可式回答的倾向较弱，且集中在认同通常合理的情境；但在 14 个模型上，推理时个性化会增加不恰当附和，尤其是将匹配的用户画像紧贴问题之前放置时。研究指出，个性化信息的位置和 judge 评分标准都是值得审查的具体 alignment 变量。

items.title: 读博的三个观察 可能有bias
items.en: 鸭基米德 offers three explicitly bias-qualified observations about PhD life: mental state correlates with publication count, two students in the same group can have opposite experiences, and under time pressure, improving figures and the introduction can be more worthwhile than running one extra experiment. The rationale is that reviewers see figures and the introduction first, while the additional experiment often ends up in the appendix; with enough time, the author recommends doing both.
items.zh: 鸭基米德 分享了三个“可能有 bias”的读博观察：精神状态和发表数正相关，同组两个人的读博体验能完全相反，时间不够时，画图和写 intro 比多跑一组实验更划算。理由是审稿人先看图和 intro，这两样决定他愿不愿意往下读，而多跑的那组实验很多时候最后塞进附录；时间够的话，当然都要做。
